audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Zed' while the content layer and the packet both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: Hwei's paints answer Living Shadow's 650 and Shadow Slash's 290 long before Death Mark exists, and the matchup runs 51.98% over 3382 games.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content chart: Hwei 1-3, Skill at 4-5 and 6, Hwei at first item and two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Windows were described without a single Zed cooldown, and dosFull[2].d called Death Mark a fifteen-second cooldown.
audit.why: Death Mark is 120/110/100s and Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16s — a wasted Death Mark is two minutes of free lane at rank 1, not fifteen seconds.
audit.corrected: All-in windows keyed to Death Mark's 120s and Living Shadow's 20s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Death Mark's untargetable dash was never stated, and spikes[1].text invented 'pre-placed Grim Portrait canvases'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to the target, and the mark repeats a portion of his damage after 3 seconds. Hwei has no ability called Grim Portrait — his E torments are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw.
audit.corrected: Do not spend paints into the untargetable dash — hold Grim Visage for the moment he lands, and use the 3-second mark timer to leave the shadow's swap range.

audit.why: Death Mark 120s at rank 1, Living Shadow 20s at rank 1, Shadow Slash 5s down to 3s.

edits.before: Carry through range — no mid pool champion paints a teamfight from further away; your R + QQ decides objectives before they start.
edits.after: Carry by punishing the landing — Death Mark drops him at 625 with a 3-second timer, and Grim Visage there wastes his 120s.

edits.before: If Zed opens the score, reset expectations and respect Death Mark doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with QA clears and stay relevant through max-range poke.
edits.after: If Zed opens the score, ward both flanks and never stand where a shadow could land behind you. After a second kill, farm with QA clears and hold Grim Visage strictly for the 120s Death Mark.

edits.before: The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: A centred wave keeps Living Shadow's 650 range short of you, and a warded flank is what stops Death Mark arriving unseen.

edits.before: QQ his last-hit, weave any second spell for the mark, detonate, and reset to max range — two-spell trades he answers only by overextending.
